d: Iran claims it can strike US military bases across Europe, raising fresh concerns over its ballistic missile programme. But how far can Tehran's missiles actually reach? From the Khorramshahr-4 missile and the reported 4,500-kilometre capability to the Diego Garcia missile incident, we examine Iran's growing military ambitions. Could its space programme pave the way for intercontinental ballistic missiles? Meanwhile, Donald Trump alleges Iran may be developing chemical or biological weapons. Tehran rejects Washington's narrative, invoking the 2003 Iraq WMD controversy and Colin Powell's…
